FN-T7UR59-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 435
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative James Lomax
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 05/09/2023
House Bill 435 as introduced will increase the election expenses of the state, paid from the State
General Fund, by an estimated minimum of $396,000 for each statewide election, beginning in
Fiscal Year 2024, by increasing the state supplemental compensation paid to election inspectors
and clerks by $50 per day, pursuant to this bill.
Page 1

FN-T7UR59-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 435
Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund Sponsor: Representative James Lomax
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 06/01/2023
House Bill 435 as passed the House of Representatives will increase the election expenses of
the state, paid from the State General Fund, by an estimated minimum of $396,000 for each
statewide election, beginning in Fiscal Year 2024, by increasing the state supplemental
compensation paid to election inspectors and clerks by $50 per day, pursuant to this bill.
